climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, hot summer

climate: Rain picks up at harvest. Growers race to pick before rot sets in, and vintages vary more.

blurb.text: A north-central Texas AVA of 2.3 million acres on the south side of Lake Texoma and the Red River, on the Texas-Oklahoma line. The name blends Texas and Oklahoma. It spans parts of Montague, Cooke, Grayson and Fannin counties.
